messages.author: b728f3845ed498d7
messages.subject: length of aes for geom_tiplab2
parts:
Hi all,

Really liking ggtree - thanks for this package.

I'm trying to use geom_tiplab2.  I have a vector of colors, the same length as the number of tips, but geom_tiplab2 doesn't like that.  What is the length of the aes attributes that geom_tiplab2 needs?

Borrowing an example from another post...


require(ape)
require(ggtree)
require(ggplot2)
set.seed(1234)
fulltree <- rtree(n=50, br=NULL)
#Plot with ggtree
ggtree(fulltree, layout="circular")+geom_tiplab(color = rep("blue", 50))
# works
ggtree(fulltree, layout="circular")+geom_tiplab2()
# works
length(fulltree$tip.label)
#[1] 50
ggtree(fulltree, layout="circular")+geom_tiplab2(color = rep("blue", 50))
# Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (48): colour, hjust
ggtree(fulltree, layout="circular")+geom_tiplab2(color = rep("blue", 48))
# Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (51): colour, hjust
ggtree(fulltree, layout="circular")+geom_tiplab2(color = rep("blue", 51))
# Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (48): colour, hjust
fulltree
# Phylogenetic tree with 50 tips and 49 internal nodes.
#
# Tip labels:
#     t14, t15, t25, t9, t35, t10, ...
#
# Rooted; no branch lengths.
ggtree(fulltree, layout="circular")+geom_tiplab2(color = rep("blue", 99))
# Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (48): colour, hjust
ggtree(fulltree, layout="circular")+geom_tiplab2(color = rep("blue", 100))
# Error: Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (48): colour, hjust

messages.author: f0dc0fdb872722c6
messages.subject: Re: length of aes for geom_tiplab2
parts:
just use

ggtree(fulltree, layout="circular")+geom_tiplab2(color = 'blue')

Referring to https://groups.google.com/forum/?utm_medium=email&utm_source=footer#!topic/bioc-ggtree/o35PV3iHO-0, geom_tiplab2 is just a short cut for

geom_tiplab(aes(subset=(abs(
angle) < 90), angle=angle), ...) + geom_tiplab(aes(subset=(abs(angle) >= 90), angle=angle+180), hjust=1, ...)

it's less flexible as geom_tiplab and just pass everything to geom_tiplab. Passing a color vector is not supported, since the color vector will pass to both geom_tiplab call and they have different lengths.

If you need to pass a color vector, use goem_tiplab instead.

messages.author: b728f3845ed498d7
messages.subject: Re: length of aes for geom_tiplab2
parts:
Thanks for the reply.  So, what if I have a vector of colors the same length as the number of tips?  When subsetting via angles, how would I subset the vector of colors so they still match the tips?  Basically, I have a vector of colors that refer to each tip, and want the tips colored appropriately, but also don't want the text upside down.

I think the larger question here is how arrange phylogenetic data in concert with dataframes.  For a ggplot framework, it would be very nice to be able specify the phylo + dataframe object in the initial call (i.e. ggtree(tr = phylodf_object)), and refer to columns of the dataframe in that object as one would in a normal ggplot call.  It seems to me that supporting phylo4d objects might be a good way to go to achieve this.  I mentioned this in a feature request in github - sorry to repeat the request here.  Any thoughts about this?

Thanks,
Alex

messages.subject: Re: length of aes for geom_tiplab2
parts:
I will consider to support phylo4d when I have some free time, I am too busy recently :(


It's possible to use color vector in geom_tiplab2 by using the %<+% operator.

x=rtree(50)
d=data.frame(lab=x$tip.label, color=sample(c('red', 'blue'), 50, replace=T))
p=ggtree(x, layout='circular') %<+% d
p + geom_tiplab2(aes(color=I(color)))
